How is the content stream data compressed within this PDF document?

The content stream stored in object 5 of this PDF is compressed using FlateDecode, which is indicated by the filter declaration '/Filter /FlateDecode' in the stream dictionary. FlateDecode is based on the zlib/deflate algorithm, the same compression method used in formats like ZIP and PNG. It is one of the most widely supported and commonly used compression filters in the PDF specification, allowing page content streams — which contain drawing instructions, text positioning commands, and graphics operators — to be stored in a much more compact binary form rather than as verbose plain text.
